auditRole: independent local provenance and bounded official web name-use review
scope: Names and city identity only. This provenance review adds no geometry, registration control, current boundary or address approval.

priorCurrentNameReview.scope: All 89 currently importer-accepted primary neighbourhood features from the pinned 20-dataset manual-source-registry snapshot; only existing primary names, no inferred/planning/local-area promotion.
priorCurrentNameReview.applicabilityToPecs67: The prior 89-feature audit contains no Pécs feature. Its counts and its 68 reprocessed OSM objects cannot be transferred to these 67 source names.

notes: The latest URL is mutable; SHA256 identifies this exact snapshot.
MD5 verifies the publisher checksum; SHA256 pins the acquired bytes.
OSM community boundaries are not necessarily official legal boundaries.

selection.nodes: Named place=suburb|quarter|neighbourhood; retained as points only
selection.municipalities: Canonical named admin_level=8 plus Budapest admin_level=6 from the same PBF

interpretation: The original immutable local snapshot represents OSM at replication timestamp 2026-11-12T21:23:05Z, acquired on 2026-11-13; it is not a live 2026-11-14 query.

The named-nodes archive selects only named place=suburb|quarter|neighbourhood nodes. Missing names may occur in other place classes, ways, relations, addresses or landuse; absence here is not name nonexistence.

This local audit checks PBF bytes/header and derived archive bytes/counts only. Reprocessing of exact Pécs object tags, coordinates, version and timestamps is handled by the separate Pécs OSM extraction, not asserted by this file.
The original OSM provider also supplied registration controls; same-provider current name evidence does not independently validate the old source contours or their geographic placement.
